images.alt_en: Dawn in the Agora: Ariston and Syros set out cups in a circle; the Painted Stoa behind.

images.alt_grc: ἐν τῇ στοᾷ οἱ νέοι περὶ τὸν Σωκράτη κύκλον πεποίηνται.
images.alt_en: In the Painted Stoa young men stand in a circle round a snub-nosed, barefoot Socrates; the Marathon painting on the wall.

images.alt_grc: ὁ Σωκράτης γελᾷ· ὁ νεανίας ὀργίζεται· ὁ Λύσις θαυμάζει.
images.alt_en: Socrates laughs, the young man scowls, Lysis listens open-mouthed.

images.alt_en: Early morning: Socrates stands motionless in the empty stoa, lost in thought; Lysis hesitates outside.

images.alt_grc: ὁ Λύσις καὶ ὁ Σωκράτης περὶ τῶν κυλίκων καὶ τῶν νεῶν διαλέγονται.
images.alt_en: Lysis talks with Socrates, counting on his fingers; a cup and a row of ships in the thought bubble.

images.alt_en: Evening in the courtyard: Lysis tells Kleinias; Elpis laughs and points to Labros under the tree.

images.alt_en: Summer 430: smoke from the ravaged countryside beyond the walls; inside, crowded huts and people sick in the shade.
